methods.label: Choose an identifiable origin and unit
methods.explanation: The origin should be chosen at a prominent location that is easy to find (such as the flagpole or school gate), and the unit length should be specified. This gives all landmarks a common coordinate system and makes their locations easy to describe.
methods.levelReason: This is a Grade 7 conceptual application of choosing a reference point and unit for geographic coordinates.
